name: private-plugins
description: Private Claude Code plugins by gutnikov.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Write any text a person will decide on (Russian or English) through a brief, a writer, a fact check, a review and one revision.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Set up and maintain a project's agent loops: design, build, validate and revise them like software, with a catalog of 88 loop types and a per-project policy for when an agent may call a person.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Write Playwright fixtures that seed the state a test starts from, and Page Objects that are the only way tests touch the UI.

plugins.name: app-probing
plugins.description: Find out what the running web app actually does with a throwaway Playwright probe: the landing URL, credentials, test ids, console errors, failed requests and a screenshot.

plugins.name: bb
plugins.description: Set up and maintain a repository's bb (getbb.app) project, where every ticket gets a manager session that runs hidden workers: init, a local or remote bb server and moves between them, and periodic tasks that start a manager with an assignment.

plugins.name: ui-prototypes
plugins.description: Sketch screens from a project's own design system and serve them at a local URL: one command for a prototypes dev server, and named prototypes that are saved as one file each.
